**What looks wrong** (one sentence — e.g. "the person is the same grey as the wall", "flickers every few frames")

**One reference frame and the matching depth frame** (drag both in)

**Command or web-page settings** (target · quality · clip both ends %)

**Clip**: resolution · fps · length · was it a phone recording, a screen recording, or a generated video?
